article.hook: That quiet ache when your résumé doesn’t match the respect you expect is louder than ever. The ache behind every achievement that still feels like a question mark is Chiron in Capricorn. It’s not about what you’ve done - it’s about what you think you deserve for doing it.
article.lived: Chiron moves through Capricorn over years, threading a long era where success and titles meet shadow. We notice the slow grind of someone triple-checking their work, not because it’s sloppy but because it never feels quite good enough. A generation measures their value in promotions held and authority earned, yet the inner tally never balances. This is visible in the way meetings stretch longer to prove a point or people rehearse their ‘I’m capable’ lines before speaking up.
article.turn: The gift turns sharp when the hunger for approval turns into silent self-sabotage: staying stuck in roles that drain instead of challenge, refusing offers that feel unearned, or shrinking your voice because you’re still tallying your worth. Chiron in Capricorn wounds by making you think you must always perform to justify your place. You don’t get to belong only if you’ve checked every box - that’s the bruise you have to name and ignore.
moves: Write a bullet list of skills you’ve never celebrated aloud and share one with a colleague.
In a meeting, ask one question that stakes your expertise without apology.
Say the exact reason you deserve a recent win, out loud, to yourself before sleep.
